signals.title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file blocked by read-set enforcement on spec file
signals.description: patch_file call on '.moeb/specifications/moeb/moeb.deprecate-patch-file-as-default-write-path.md' during the Per-Step Review Sub-Loop returned 'write_file rejected: exists on disk but has not been read during this run.' The spec file was created with write_file in Phase 4 and not added to the read set, so patch_file was rejected by read-set enforcement. The intended improvement (adding no-signal-reoccurrence to the rubric table) was not applied.
signals.proposed_resolution: Add an explicit read_file call for the spec file path immediately after write_file in Phase 4 to add it to the read set before the review sub-loop begins. Alternatively, update the kernel to implicitly add newly-created files to the read set.

signals.title: patch_file systematic line insertion failure corrupted README.md
signals.description: Four patch_file calls on .moeb/README.md each reported 'applied' with no error, but every hunk that added a net new line produced the same line count (234 -> 234) instead of inserting a new line. Required 4 additional read_file_range calls and a full write_file rewrite (52157 bytes) to restore correct formatting.
signals.proposed_resolution: Investigate the diffy crate's behavior when applying zero-context insertion hunks to LF-normalized files. Add a unit test that patches a file by inserting a new line and verifies the line count increases by 1.

signals.title: Missing moeb tool: read-absolute-path for tool result files
signals.description: Native Claude Code Read tool was used to read start_spec output file at an absolute path outside the working directory. No moeb equivalent exists.
signals.proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a streaming or chunked tool-result retrieval mechanism so large MCP tool outputs do not require an external file read.

signals.title: Phase 4 review sub-loop structurally blocked on newly-created spec files
signals.description: The Per-Step Review Sub-Loop in Phase 4 of spec.skill.md cannot modify the spec file because the file was created (not read) in the same run, violating read-set enforcement. This blocks every spec session's review loop from functioning.
signals.proposed_resolution: Add an explicit read_file call for the spec file path after write_file in Phase 4, before the review sub-loop begins.

signals.title: Spec rubric missing no-signal-reoccurrence criterion for signal-lifecycle trait
signals.description: Step 6 of moeb.deprecate-patch-file-as-default-write-path closes signal files, triggering the signal-lifecycle trait, but no-signal-reoccurrence is absent from the spec's rubric table. The patch_file attempt to add it failed due to read-set enforcement.
signals.proposed_resolution: The implementing run agent should add no-signal-reoccurrence to the spec's rubric table using read_file + write_file.
